record.title: Sweden conditional COVID admission prohibition at Øresund, late2021–early2022 phase
record.endpoint_type: legal repeal of conditional EEA entry prohibition
record.scope: Denmark-to-Sweden Øresund international road/rail link; route component of wider EEA entry policy
record.crossings: Øresund / Öresundsbron; Lernacken road control; rail legal route scope
record.movement: Foreign passengers lacking required health evidence or status exemption; goods transport personnel exempt
record.exceptions: Swedish citizens outside foreign-national rule; residents, freight/transport staff and other status exemptions. Later phase exempts under18s and permits vaccination/recovery/72hourtest certificates. Earlier exact exception list preserved in frozen legal-reference record.
record.enforcement: Legal refusal mandate; Lernacken refusal reporting via a press/operator chain. Universal enforcement and rail-specific refusal counts not established.
record.consequences: Queues reported at Lernacken; no independently verified2022-only refusal total entered

record.official_rationale: Prevent importation and spread of COVID-19 variants
record.context: Stricter negative-test phase effective28December2021;21January2022 vaccination/recovery alternatives restored; EEA rule repealed9February2022.
record.uncertainty: Policy phase within longer legal lineage; not first pandemic onset. Early original legal PDF opened by blind researcher but root/reviewer retries failed.
